comparison.objective: Wrap a flexible line one full turn around a bollard and place its end; candidate tunes a rigid damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing and wrapping versus hex-key use, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: One complete turn, end in tray, both grippers released versus repeatable non-bottoming stops. Wrap tightness is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Flexible-line manipulation is materially different from rigid adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
